title: Digi XBee Delivers Mission-Critical Wireless Mesh Performance Behind the World’s Largest Drone Light Shows
summary: HighGreat Technology sets a Guinness World Record orchestrating 8,100 drones with reliable, secure, and scalable Digi XBee and DigiMesh connectivity.
